about.title: Tradition that becomes an experience
about.p1: In a quiet corner of Vyronas we created a small cafe from a love of coffee, wholesome food, and the aromas of Greek soil. It began with the dried fig of Taxiarches, Evia — a small fruit full of memory, flavor, and care.
about.p2: Here every drink and every bite has a reason to exist. Our aim is everyday moments of pleasure and hospitality, always with a smile.

stubs.aboutBody: Figata Cafe was born in Vyronas from a love of coffee, dried figs, and authentic Greek flavors. Come meet us in person.
stubs.menuBody: The full menu is being prepared for the new site. Until then, ask us in the shop — coffee, drinks, figs, and sweets are waiting every day.
stubs.productsBody: Wholesale dried figs, specialty coffee, and handmade creations with the aroma of Greek soil.
stubs.galleryBody: Moments from Figata: the space, the coffee, the figs, and the people who pass through Vyronas.
stubs.contactBody: Find us at Agias Sofias 128 in Vyronas. Call or drop by for a coffee.
